name: Flow Step
description: You enter a trance at your current location and step back in time to observe past events that occurred there. You choose how far back to look, up to 1 year. Your body enters stasis while your awareness travels to that moment. You can observe events as they unfolded in real time from your fixed position but cannot interact with anything. The vision lasts up to 10 minutes of real time.
charge: You can look back up to 100 years and bring up to 2 willing allies into the vision with you.
